# Labs64 NetLicensing

Labs64 NetLicensing is a license management software designed to help software vendors and developers efficiently manage their software licenses and distribution.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/labs64-netlicensing/.

## Actions

- **List Licenses** (read-only): List all licenses.
- **List Products** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all products.
